metric_definitions.included_phase: Consecutive drive samples only; first sample is baseline; settle and final forced braking excluded
metric_definitions.ego_speed: Measured planar chassis speed; acceleration and jerk are scalar-speed derivatives/tangential approximations
metric_definitions.background_speed: Measured body-forward velocity during drive; full 120 Hz derivatives cannot be rebuilt independently from decimated planner records
metric_definitions.headway: Measured geometric net gap / ego speed when leader and moving ego exist; not preferred gap
metric_definitions.ttc: Closing TTC only; null when nonclosing; near-zero positive closing produces very large finite values
metric_definitions.near_miss_proxy: Exact clearance below 1 m OR closing TTC below 1.5 s; contiguous observed ego-level episodes
metric_definitions.fairness: Per-lifetime loss normalized by observed exposure, at least 1 s eligibility; Jain index of achieved fractions; descriptive heterogeneous scripted cohort
metric_definitions.identity: Generation-aware active lifetimes; dormant slots excluded; retirement/run censoring retained

timing_interpretation.scope: Diagnostic captured startup and interactive endpoint, not matched performance comparisons
timing_interpretation.rtf_scope: Simulation duration divided by active wall time including live settle/drive/brake/recording; startup and explicit pauses excluded
timing_interpretation.native_delivery_scope: Kit NEW_FRAME notifications, not verified unique monitor scanouts, FPS, or mouse-to-photon latency
